title: Two Airbnb listings: performance and listing audit
text:
# Audit packet: two Airbnb listings, same host, Rock River, southern Wisconsin (Nov 1, 2026)

Context: both listings were rewritten today for Airbnb's AI search (Sept 30, 2026 update: matches guests' plain-language requests to listing text, ticked amenities and reviews; writes AI highlights; summary max 500 chars; accuracy scored). Insights below cover Sep 30 to Oct 30, 2026, BEFORE the rewrite. Pricing is set by the host in Hospitable (a pricing tool), not Airbnb Smart Pricing. Both listings: Superhost, Guest favorite, Top 5% of homes, 5.0 rating.

## Airbnb insights, last 30 days (Sep 30 to Oct 30)
Metric | The Overhang (sleeps 10, 4 king, 3.5 bath, Janesville) | The Ravines (sleeps 12, 5 king, 3 bath, Beloit)
Occupancy | 22.2% (6 nights booked of 27, 3 check-ins); 25.1 pts below similar listings | 40.7% (11 of 27, 5 check-ins); 7.4 pts below similar
Average nightly rate | about $1,030; $706 above 'similar listings' | about $1,130; $900 above 'similar listings'
Note | Airbnb's 'similar listings' set prices near $230 to $330 a night, so it is likely smaller homes, not true peers | same
Page views | 1,374 (down 53 vs prior 30 days; 1,020 above similar) | 2,347 (up 186; 2,058 above similar)
First-page search impressions | 5,136 | 9,117
First-page search impression rate | 50.1% | 59.1%
Search-to-listing click rate | 26.75% | 25.74%
Listing-to-booking rate | 0.44% | 1.02%
Overall conversion | 0.10% (0.12 pts below similar) | 0.26% (0.06 pts below similar)
Average stay | 2.0 nights | 2.4 nights
Booking lead time | 43 days | 39 days
Reviews | 27 reviews; category: cleanliness 5.0, accuracy 5.0, check-in 5.0, communication 5.0, location 4.9, value 4.8 | 102 reviews; location 4.9, value 4.9, rest 5.0
Upcoming confirmed stays (as of Nov 1) | 3 total: Nov 14 to 16, Dec 30 to Jan 2, Jul 8 to 11 2027 | 15 total: 4 in Nov, 2 in Dec, 2 in Jan, 1 in Feb, then May to Aug 2027

Airbnb 'Opportunities' not taken (both listings unless noted): allow pets (host rule: no pets); add a crib (Ravines has one, Overhang has a pack n play only); welcome short stays (lower minimum stay); early bird discount; last-minute discount; laptop-friendly workspace (Ravines has one; Overhang has no desk, stated in listing).

## Review themes (from all reviews, no names)
Overhang: praise for theater, hot tub under the cantilever, sauna, design, cleanliness, host. Three separate reviews say the house is better than the photos. One family said the area is a bit lacking in kid activities. Value is the lowest category (4.8).
Ravines: praise for hot tub, sauna, all-king bedrooms, host, cleanliness. One guest flagged the steep driveway and very dark roads at night with no street lights (arrive before dark). One review raised light sleepers; host replied white noise machines would be added (not confirmed in place). One guest praised that checkout only asks guests to carry out what they brought.

## Live listing text: The Overhang • Architect-Designed + Sauna/Hot Tub

### summary
An architect-designed home on a private bluff above the Rock River in Janesville, under 2 hours from Chicago and 45 minutes from Madison. Sleeps 10 in four king bedrooms plus a queen sofa bed, with 3.5 baths, about 3,600 sq ft. Private hot tub and outdoor sauna under the cantilever, a fire bowl patio over the river, a movie theater, an arcade and a gas fireplace. Pack n play, high chair and a Level 2 EV charger. Built for families, friend groups, milestone weekends and small team retreats.


### space
The Overhang sits on a private bluff above the Rock River, wrapped in charred-wood siding, with a giant round window that frames the water. It has three levels: one to gather, one to sleep, one to play.

Upper level: gather and cook
Reclaimed-wood ceiling beams and the round window over the river. A chef's kitchen with an oversized island and a Forno gas range. A gas fireplace in the living room, a hammock chair, board games and a coffee bar with drip, French press and pour-over. The queen sofa bed is here for bigger groups.

Main level: sleep
Three king bedrooms and two full bathrooms, including a spa-style bath with a microcement tub. A kitchenette for late snacks and early coffee. Step straight out to the hot tub, sauna and fire bowl patio.

Lower level: play and watch
A movie theater with a large screen and surround sound, an arcade, a fourth king bedroom and a full bathroom. Kids and teens can take this level over, and the king room down here suits anyone who wants some privacy.

Outdoors
The hot tub sits under the cantilevered house and looks out over the river. The sauna is a wood-lined room with a window to the trees. The fire bowl patio overlooks the river bluff. Mature trees surround the property and change color in fall. There's a BBQ grill, a hammock and outdoor furniture. In winter, go from the sauna to the cold night air and back.

Sleeping arrangements
Bedroom 1: king bed, main level
Bedroom 2: king bed, main level
Bedroom 3: king bed, main level
Bedroom 4: king bed, lower level
Living room: queen sofa bed, upper level
Best for 8 in real beds, room for 10 with the sofa bed.

For little ones: a pack n play with sheets, a folding high chair, a changing table, fireplace guards, and books and toys for ages 0 to 5.

Good for
Families and multigenerational trips: four king beds for the adults and a lower level for the kids.
Two families sharing one house, each with two king bedrooms.
Friend groups marking a milestone: 40th birthdays, anniversaries, girls' weekends, bachelor and bachelorette weekends within your booked group.
Small team retreats and offsites for 8 to 10.
Couples or small groups who want a quiet sauna and hot tub weekend.

Drive times
Chicago Loop: under 2 hours
O'Hare: about 90 minutes
Madison and UW campus: 45 minutes
Milwaukee: 75 minutes
Lake Geneva: 50 minutes
Rockford, IL: 40 minutes
New Glarus: 35 minutes
Galena, IL: 90 minutes

Nearby
Rotary Botanical Gardens: 15 minutes. New Glarus Brewing: 35 minutes. Madison's State Street, Memorial Union Terrace and Capitol Square: 45 minutes. Beloit's Ironworks district and Beloit College: 15 minutes.

The Overhang is part of Outlandia, a small collection of architect-designed homes in southern Wisconsin.


### access
You have the whole house on all three levels and the outdoor spaces: the hot tub, outdoor sauna, fire bowl patio, theater, arcade, fitness equipment, balconies, and a washer and dryer.

A few areas are closed to guests: locked storage closets, the garage, and the stairs and other access points down to the river.


### other
Check-in 3:00 PM, checkout 10:00 AM, self check-in with a smart lock.
Up to 10 guests. No visitors beyond your booked group.
No smoking anywhere on the property. No pets.
Birthdays, anniversaries and bachelor or bachelorette weekends are welcome for your booked group only. No parties or events of any kind.
A lawn service visits on weekdays, usually Wednesday, depending on the weather.
There are two exterior cameras: a doorbell camera at the front door and a floodlight camera over the parking area.
The house has stairs between its three levels and isn't wheelchair accessible.
There's no dedicated work desk in the house.


### neighborhood
A quiet residential neighborhood above the Rock River in Janesville. The house sits among mature trees that change with every season. Rock River Heritage County Park is just down the road. Restaurants, coffee shops and groceries are a short drive away. Rotary Botanical Gardens is 15 minutes, Beloit is 15 minutes south, and Madison is 45 minutes north.


### getting-around
You'll want a car. Parking is free on site, and there's a Level 2 EV charger. Janesville is right off I-90/39, an easy drive from Chicago, Milwaukee and Madison.


### interaction with guests
Self check-in with a smart lock. Message me through the Airbnb app with any questions before or during your stay.
Scenic views ticked: River view. Accessibility features: none (house has stairs). Wifi: ticked, no speed shown.

## Live listing text: The Ravines • Riverfront A-Frame + Cedar Tub/Sauna

### summary
A modern A-frame on the Rock River near Beloit, under 2 hours from Chicago. Sleeps 12 in five king bedrooms plus a queen sofa bed, with 3 full baths. A cedar hot tub, barrel sauna and fire table by the deck overlooking the river. Private dock with 2 tandem kayaks in summer, a vintage arcade, a pool table, 237 Mbps wifi, a dedicated workspace and a Level 2 EV charger. Crib, high chair and kids' toys on hand. Built for family gatherings, friend getaways and remote-work stays.


### space
The Ravines is a modern A-frame above the Rock River, with floor-to-ceiling windows, warm wood and river views from the double deck.

Outdoors
A cedar hot tub, a barrel sauna with cedar benches, and a fire table with Adirondack chairs, all by the deck overlooking the river. Steps lead down through the trees to a private dock, with 2 tandem kayaks in the summer months. There's also a BBQ grill, a hammock, sun loungers and outdoor furniture.

Inside
An indoor fireplace, a living room with a big wall TV next to the games, a dining table for 8, and a 47-inch freestanding Japanese soaking tub. Air conditioning and central heat. The kitchen has a Thor 6-burner gas stove, a dishwasher, and a coffee bar with a Nespresso Vertuo, French press, pour-over and a grinder.

Games and fitness
A vintage arcade machine with 30,000+ games, a pool table, a game console, a home gym, and TVs with Roku downstairs.

Sleeping arrangements
Bedrooms 1 to 5: one king bed each
Living room: queen sofa bed
Sleeps up to 12.

For little ones: a crib, a pack n play, a high chair, a changing table, fireplace guards, and books and toys for ages 0 to 5.

Work: 237 Mbps wifi and a dedicated workspace.

Good for
Family gatherings, with a king bed in every bedroom.
Friend groups who want a sauna and hot tub weekend on the river.
Remote-work stays.
Summer paddling from the dock and fishing on the Rock River.
Winter sauna nights and hot tub soaks.

The Ravines is part of Outlandia, a small collection of homes in southern Wisconsin.


### access
You have the whole house, the deck, the hot tub, sauna, fire table, gym and games, plus the dock and kayaks (kayaks in summer only).

A few areas are closed to guests: 3 storage closets with keypad locks (2 in the basement, 1 on the main floor) and the old shed by the river. For your safety, please stay away from the shed.


### other
Check-in after 3:00 PM, checkout by 10:00 AM. No early check-ins. Keypad entry. At checkout, lock the front door by pressing the Yale icon on the keypad.
Up to 12 guests. Quiet hours 9:00 PM to 7:00 AM.
No pets, no smoking or vaping, no parties or events.
Two exterior cameras: a doorbell camera and one over the parking area. Both cover outdoor areas only.
Kitchen: bring your own groceries, condiments and spices. A spare roll of kitchen towels, garbage bags and dishwasher pods are under the sink.
Coffee: Nespresso pods are provided. Bring your own coffee for the French press or pour-over; there's a grinder.
Bathrooms: shampoo, conditioner, body wash, hand soap, 2 extra rolls of toilet paper per bathroom, and a set of bath towels for each guest.
Laundry: washer and dryer, with detergent pods and dryer balls.
The 2 downstairs TVs have Roku in guest mode, so sign in with your own accounts.
Wifi details come before arrival and are in the house guide.


### neighborhood
A quiet, rural spot along the Rock River outside Beloit, surrounded by trees. Fish the Rock River, paddle from the dock in summer, or walk the nature trails nearby. Downtown Beloit's restaurants and shops are about 10 minutes away, and groceries (Piggly Wiggly, Walmart, Woodman's Market) are 10 to 20 minutes.


### getting-around
You'll want a car, since public transit is limited. Parking is free on the gravel driveway, and there's a Level 2 EV charger. Downtown Beloit is about 10 minutes, Rock County Airport about 20 minutes, O'Hare about 90 minutes, and Chicago under 2 hours.
question: You are auditing two live Airbnb listings for the host, using the Airbnb insights and review themes in the packet. Be blunt and brief. Use first principles: state what actually drives bookings here, then find where each listing loses guests. 1) Diagnosis: for The Overhang, explain the gap with The Ravines step by step through the funnel (search impressions, clicks, listing-to-booking) and name the most likely causes, ranked. 2) Listing text weaknesses: anything vague, buried, missing, or likely to hurt AI search matching or accuracy, for each listing, with exact replacement wording that uses only facts in the packet. 3) Non-text levers: photos, amenities to tick, pricing and discount ideas (the host sets prices in Hospitable, so frame these as tests), minimum stay, reviews. 4) Top five actions across both listings, ranked by expected booking impact, each with how to measure it. Never invent amenities, distances or facts. Flag anything you would need the host to confirm.
